title: Flower / Japanese billboard
slide_intent: Adapt language without losing recognizable imagery because international expression needs both continuity and local readability.
strategic_value: The textured flower and green surfaces can connect a Japanese-language placement with Wise’s wider visual family.
demonstration: Two sides of a tall urban billboard pair vertical Japanese lettering with a textured flower and a Wise signature.
practical_value: Compare a shared illustration’s role across scripts and outdoor proportions.
